remarks: Welcome to this stylish 2-bedroom condo in the heart of Norwalk, offering modern comfort and unbeatable convenience. The updated kitchen features sleek granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a clean, contemporary design perfect for everyday living or entertaining. A new water heater was installed in 2021, adding peace of mind. The well-maintained complex has recently redone the decks, roofs, and siding, enhancing both curb appeal and long-term value. Enjoy added perks like a dedicated storage unit, one reserved parking space, and ample visitor parking. Just minutes from The SoNo Collection, vibrant restaurants, museums, beaches, boating, and a community garden-with easy access to both Rowayton and SoNo Metro North stations-this location truly has it all.
